narrative: NII is €97.0M year-to-date, 7% below last year and €7.5M behind budget. Lending margins held — the corporate margin keeps rising — but financing costs on covered bonds and senior debt moved faster, and group hedges delay the upside of higher market rates into 2027. Focus stays the ALM engine: its balance-sheet value forecasts and NII flow into Snowflake, FP&A adjusts them, and the adjusted values flow back to Focus [interface design TBC].

signals.excerpt: NII €97.0M, commissions €96.0M (+4%), life insurance €20.9M (−8%); comparable CIR 63%; credit losses a net €3.5M release; comparable ROE 14.0%.

signals.excerpt: The positive effect of higher market rates on NII is expected to become visible next year.
